desc:
This move can be played if the ladder by playing <X:O15> is good for white. White at some point might want to extend at the same point <X:O15>. There is a weak point for black at <A:S14>. As is black has more potential to attack white, but this can depend on the rest of the board.

See [AI Joseki #1 The Direct 3-3 Invasion variation 1](https://youtu.be/JLUyBCZIGKQ?t=966).
